== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[TIE Vanguard (Japanese)|TIE Vanguard]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709602/BJwzpK2DqEa1p2JGmRMRww.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960106.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7ee14cec8aedd2cbd84c1e93c9e787a24aefe1d7ee9da4d87d8257e2eadf9984</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
